title: ReportViewer
wrapsNative: NavigationStack with navigationTitle, a ScrollView with refreshable, a ToolbarItem(placement: .primaryAction) holding MonarchDownloadReportButton, a segmented Picker for the period, a LazyVGrid of MonarchStatCard (the kpi-row recipe), MonarchChartFrame around a Swift Charts Chart, and a NavigationLink that pushes MonarchDataTable(layout: .list)
summary: A recipe, not a component: one report on its own screen, with the title, what the figures cover and when they were generated, the period filter, headline figures, a chart, the rows on a pushed screen, notes and a download button.
whenToUse: When an app opens one report from its list of reports (headcount, revenue, ticket volume) and the person reads the figures, filters them and downloads the file.
whenNotToUse: For a dashboard of many widgets use MonarchDashboardGrid with MonarchWidget. For an editable list of records use MonarchDataTable on its own list screen. For one figure on another screen use MonarchStatCard.
api: NavigationStack { ScrollView { VStack { Text(scope and generated time); Picker("Period", …).pickerStyle(.segmented); LazyVGrid { MonarchStatCard(…) }; MonarchChartFrame(…) { Chart { … } }; NavigationLink { MonarchDataTable(…, layout: .list) } label: { … }; Text(notes) } }.refreshable { … }.navigationTitle(title).toolbar { ToolbarItem(placement: .primaryAction) { MonarchDownloadReportButton(formats: …) { … } } } }

Loading: MonarchLoadingState("Loading report", variant: .detail). Forbidden and not found: MonarchEmptyState(title, message:, systemImage:) without a retry. Failed: MonarchInlineErrorRetry(message) { … }. No rows: MonarchEmptyState(…, kind: .filtered).

options.name: title
options.description: The report's name, as the large navigation title; the back button returns to the list of reports.

options.name: scope and generated time
options.description: What the figures cover and when they were generated, in the muted caption style right under the title.

options.name: filters
options.description: A segmented Picker for a few periods; for more filters use the filter-bar recipe (chips in the top safe-area inset and a Filters sheet).

options.name: summary
options.description: Headline figures in the kpi-row recipe: two columns, one at accessibility text sizes.

options.name: chart
options.description: A Swift Charts chart in MonarchChartFrame, whose table toggle gives the same numbers as a table.

options.name: rows
options.description: The full table on a pushed screen, in the list layout, so the report screen scrolls once and the table scrolls on its own.

options.name: notes
options.description: Footnotes under the figures, in the muted caption style.

options.name: download
options.description: In the primary toolbar slot; disable it while loading or failed.

states.name: ready
states.description: Scope, filters, figures, chart, the rows link and notes.

states.name: loading
states.description: MonarchLoadingState with the detail variant and "Loading report"; the download button is disabled.

states.name: refreshing
states.description: Pull to refresh (refreshable) keeps the previous result visible while the report runs again, with the system refresh indicator.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState of the filtered kind under the filters: "No results" and a hint to change them.

states.name: forbidden
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with a lock: "You cannot open this report" and who to ask; no retry.

states.name: not found
states.description: MonarchEmptyState: "This report does not exist"; no retry.

appearance: The system navigation bar and large title, Monarch stat cards and chart frame on the canvas background, scope and notes in the muted text colour, and the chart's bars in the first data colour. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web ships ReportViewer as one component that lays out the header, back link, filters, badges, summary, chart, a built-in table, notes and download on a wide page. On a phone it is a recipe of system navigation and Monarch components: the back link is the navigation stack's back button, the title is the navigation title, download sits in the toolbar, and the table moves to a pushed screen instead of sitting below the chart, because a wide table does not fit beside other content on a phone and a nested scrolling table is hard to use. The web's refreshing state becomes the system pull to refresh. Print styles do not apply. The web's built-in columns and rows table is MonarchDataTable here. Android has the same recipe coverage and status (available).
accessibility: The navigation title is read first; the back button names the previous screen.
The summary grid is a container named "Summary"; each MonarchStatCard is read as its label, value and change.
MonarchChartFrame's table toggle gives VoiceOver the chart's numbers as a table.
The rows link is a standard navigation link with a 44-point minimum height.
Loading, forbidden and empty states are text, with decorative symbols.
MonarchDownloadReportButton announces progress and the result.
edgeCases: Leave out the chart and figures the report does not have instead of showing empty frames.
At accessibility text sizes the figures stack in one column and the chart keeps its height while the table toggle remains available.
Long report titles use the inline title style when they do not fit the large title.
Forbidden and not found offer no retry, because trying again cannot help.

examples.template:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space4) {
    Text({{back}})
        .monarchTextStyle(.body)
        .underline()
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textLink)
    HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space1) {
            Text({{title}})
                .monarchTextStyle(.title)
            Text({{description}})
                .monarchTextStyle(.body)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
        }
        Spacer()
        MonarchDownloadReportButton(
            formats: [
                MonarchDownloadReportFormat({{download.formats.0.label}}, id: {{download.formats.0.id}}),
                MonarchDownloadReportFormat({{download.formats.1.label}}, id: {{download.formats.1.id}}),
            ],
            labels: MonarchDownloadReportButtonLabels(label: {{download.label}})
        ) { _ in
            .downloaded
        }
    }
    MonarchPeriodSelector(
        selection: $period,
        presets: [{{periods.presets.0}}, {{periods.presets.1}}, {{periods.presets.2}}, {{periods.presets.3}}]
            .compactMap { MonarchPeriodPreset(rawValue: $0) },
        today: {{periods.today|date}}
    )
    MonarchFlowLayout(spacing: theme.spacing.space2, rowSpacing: theme.spacing.space1, alignment: .center) {
        Text({{scope}})
        Text(generated)
        MonarchBadge({{badge.text}}, tone: {{badge.tone|tone}})
    }
    .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
    HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
        MonarchStatCard({{kpis.0.label}}, value: {{kpis.0.value}}, size: .sm)
        MonarchStatCard({{kpis.1.label}}, value: {{kpis.1.value}}, size: .sm)
        MonarchStatCard({{kpis.2.label}}, value: {{kpis.2.value}}, size: .sm)
    }
    MonarchDataTable(
        {{title}},
        rows: rows,
        columns: [
            MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.0.label}}, id: {{columns.0.key}}, isHideable: false, value: { $0.team }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.1.label}}, id: {{columns.1.key}}, isNumeric: true, value: { "\($0.headcount)" }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.2.label}}, id: {{columns.2.key}}, isNumeric: true, value: { "\($0.joiners)" }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.3.label}}, id: {{columns.3.key}}, isNumeric: true, value: { "\($0.leavers)" }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn({{columns.4.label}}, id: {{columns.4.key}}, value: { $0.remote ? "Yes" : "No" }),
        ],
        layout: .list
    )
    Text({{notes.0}})
        .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
}
examples.code:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space4) {
    Text("All reports")
        .monarchTextStyle(.body)
        .underline()
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textLink)
    HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
        VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space1) {
            Text("Headcount by team")
                .monarchTextStyle(.title)
            Text("People on the payroll at the end of the period.")
                .monarchTextStyle(.body)
                .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
        }
        Spacer()
        MonarchDownloadReportButton(
            formats: [
                MonarchDownloadReportFormat("CSV", id: "csv"),
                MonarchDownloadReportFormat("Excel", id: "xlsx"),
            ],
            labels: MonarchDownloadReportButtonLabels(label: "Download")
        ) { _ in
            .downloaded
        }
    }
    MonarchPeriodSelector(
        selection: $period,
        presets: ["30d", "this-quarter", "this-year", "custom"]
            .compactMap { MonarchPeriodPreset(rawValue: $0) },
        today: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_794_009_600)
    )
    MonarchFlowLayout(spacing: theme.spacing.space2, rowSpacing: theme.spacing.space1, alignment: .center) {
        Text("All locations")
        Text(generated)
        MonarchBadge("Contains pay figures", tone: .warning)
    }
    .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
    .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
    HStack(spacing: theme.spacing.space3) {
        MonarchStatCard("Headcount", value: 73, size: .sm)
        MonarchStatCard("Joined", value: 8, size: .sm)
        MonarchStatCard("Left", value: 3, size: .sm)
    }
    MonarchDataTable(
        "Headcount by team",
        rows: rows,
        columns: [
            MonarchDataTableColumn("Team", id: "team", isHideable: false, value: { $0.team }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn("Headcount", id: "headcount", isNumeric: true, value: { "\($0.headcount)" }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn("Joined", id: "joiners", isNumeric: true, value: { "\($0.joiners)" }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn("Left", id: "leavers", isNumeric: true, value: { "\($0.leavers)" }),
            MonarchDataTableColumn("Remote", id: "remote", value: { $0.remote ? "Yes" : "No" }),
        ],
        layout: .list
    )
    Text("Contractors are excluded.")
        .monarchTextStyle(.caption)
        .foregroundStyle(theme.colors.textMuted)
}
